title: Critique: similarity between stages is always in a respect

statements.text: Block agrees with Lamme about what is conscious but rejects his method. Whether local recurrence is more like the feedforward sweep or like global access depends on the metric: in involving no frontal activity it is more like the sweep. The choice of figure-ground and binding as the metric is an inference to the best explanation, not a criterion intrinsic to neuroscience.

sources.quote: He and I agree almost completely about what is conscious and what is not and the reasoning why, but not on the abstract methodological description.
There is no abstract issue of whether I2 is more like I1 than I3.
